The structure of Ti6Ge8Se16 (reduced formula Ti3Ge4Se8) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 30 atoms per unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with 6 neighbors (2 Ge, 4 Se) and Ti centers in both a 6-neighbor Se coordination and an octahedral Ti environment with 3 Ge and 3 Se neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies edge-sharing between Ti octahedra.
